description: Sends a message to a channel.

channel.description: Channel, private group, or IM channel to send message to. Can be an encoded ID, or a name.

text.description: The message text. Required when not using blocks or attachments.

blocks.description: A JSON-based array of structured blocks.

attachments.description: A JSON-based array of structured attachments.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's ts value to make this message a reply.

reply_broadcast.description: Used with thread_ts to broadcast reply to channel. Default: false.

mrkdwn.description: Enable Slack markup parsing. Default: true.

unfurl_media.description: Enable unfurling of media content. Default: true.

metadata.description: JSON object with event_type and event_payload fields.
